en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central European city street with multi‑story historic buildings flanking a wide thoroughfare. A prominent baroque church tower with a clock rises on the right side in the distance. Small figures, carriages, and shop awnings line the street. Decorative red Gothic-style script in German appears in the upper right and lower left corners, and fine print is along the left edge and bottom.
